name: Noel The Nextseason
original_name: ノエル・ザ・ネクストシーズン
source:
Iris's servant. Because she thinks she isn't worthy of speaking to a noble, she conveys her intentions by using her pre-recorded voice on a tape recorder. She's very athletic and is always willing to give her best for Iris's sake.

“There's no way I'd even consider using my voice to speak to a noble.”
